يستكرها (form X)
# يَسْتَكْرِهَا (yastakrihā) /jas.tak.ri.haː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# يُسْتَكْرَهَا (yustakrahā) /jus.tak.ra.haː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
